benefits.text:
BBIA Over Glaze Lip Gloss is a gloss/glaze that gives lips a plump, juicy, glossy-smooth and radiant effect, like a soft layer of light over the lips. It helps lips look fuller, softer and more lively, and can be worn alone for a natural glossy-lip effect or layered over lip color to add plumpness and depth.

The smooth texture glides on easily and hugs the lip surface evenly, minimizing a sticky, heavy feel on the lips. The glaze layer helps lightly fill lip lines as a makeup effect, so the lip surface looks plump, smooth and softer. The formula, rich in nourishing avocado oil and jojoba seed oil, helps lips feel moist and smooth and comfortable throughout wear, and also suits lips prone to dryness.

In the new shade edition, the product has improved color payoff and color depth compared with ordinary sheer glosses. The high-density glazing texture creates a thick, smooth glossy layer that helps the color show more clearly without too much layering. The Cool & Bouncy effect gives a light cooling feel on application, combined with a soft plumping effect so lips look plumper, without harsh tingling.

The new collection [shades 19-23], inspired by slow-cooked caramel, brings warm, deep caramel nude shades that are glossy, plump and have more depth. Unlike the clear syrup feel, this collection focuses on more visible color payoff, a softer and sweeter mood, and a more expressive glazed lips effect.

Apple Edition is an S/S collection inspired by fresh, juicy apple juice. For Over Glaze, the collection mood comes through a clear, glossy, plump syrup lip effect: Green Apple leans fresh and clear; Red Apple leans toward a sweet apple red that is radiant and more striking.

safety.text:
For external use on the lip area only; do not use on damaged lips,
Stop use if any unusual signs appear and keep out of reach of children.

Can be used alone or over a matte lipstick to add shine and maintain color for longer.
